units.source_text: 夕雾以前来访，从来不曾如此长留，也不曾显露轻薄之相。

en.t: When Yugiri had visited before, he had never stayed so long, nor had he ever shown any sign of frivolous intent.

units.source_text: 今夜这般模样，落叶公主觉得很可担忧。

en.t: Seeing him behave this way tonight, Princess Ochiba felt deeply uneasy.

units.source_text: 然而轻率地逃往老夫人那边，又觉得不成样子，只得默默无声地坐着。

en.t: Yet she felt it would look improper to flee rashly to the old lady, so she could only sit there in silence.

units.source_text: 夕雾对侍女随便说些话，渐渐靠近帘前。

en.t: Yugiri spoke casually with the waiting woman and gradually moved closer to the curtain.

units.source_text: 侍女膝行入内传言时，他就跟了进去。

en.t: When the waiting woman shuffled inside on her knees to deliver his message, he followed her in.

units.source_text: 此时夜雾深锁窗户，室内光线幽暗，侍女回头看见夕雾进来，吃了一惊。

en.t: By then the night mist had shut the windows in gloom, and the room was dim; when the waiting woman looked back and saw Yugiri entering, she was startled.

units.source_text: 公主困窘不堪，连忙膝行而去，闯出了北面的纸隔扇。

en.t: The princess was unbearably distressed and hurriedly shuffled away on her knees, bursting through the paper partition to the north.

units.source_text: 夕雾敏捷地赶上，把她拉住。

en.t: Yugiri swiftly caught up with her and held her back.

units.source_text: 公主的身体已经进入邻室，但衣裾还留在这边。

en.t: The princess had already got her body into the adjoining room, but the hem of her robe remained on this side.

units.source_text: 纸隔扇那边没有钩环，只得任其半开半闭，身上冷汗像水一般流出。

en.t: There was no hook on the far side of the paper partition, so she had to leave it half open and half closed, while cold sweat poured from her like water.

units.source_text: 众侍女都吓得呆若木鸡，不知此时应该如何对付。

en.t: All the waiting women were frozen with fright and had no idea how they should handle the situation.

units.source_text: 纸隔扇这边原装着锁，然而她们又不敢蛮不讲理地把这贵人拉开而把门锁上，

en.t: There was in fact a lock on this side of the paper partition, but they did not dare to rudely pull such a noble gentleman away and lock the door.

units.source_text: 只得哭丧着脸叫道：“哎呀！这算什么样子呢？想不到这位大人会起这种念头啊！”

en.t: They could only cry out with stricken faces, "Oh no! What sort of scene is this? We never imagined this gentleman would have such thoughts!"

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“我但求如此接近公主而已，你们何必大惊小怪呢？

en.t: Yugiri replied, "All I ask is to come this close to the princess; why must you make such a fuss?

units.source_text: 我虽微不足道，但多年以来的诚意，你们总该早就知道了吧。”

en.t: Though I am of little worth, surely you have long known the sincerity I have shown for so many years."

units.source_text: 他就不慌不忙地诉说他的心事。

en.t: He then calmly began to pour out what was in his heart.

units.source_text: 但公主哪里要听！

en.t: But how could the princess possibly want to listen?

units.source_text: 她只觉得遭此奇耻大辱，心中万分委屈，一句答话也说不出来。

en.t: She felt only that she had suffered an extraordinary humiliation, and in her deep distress she could not utter a single word in reply.

units.source_text: 夕雾说道：“公主如此不讲情理，竟同无知小孩一样！

en.t: Yugiri said, "Princess, you are being so unreasonable, just like an ignorant child!

units.source_text: 我满怀隐痛，难于忍受，因而行动稍稍越礼，此罪自不容辞。

en.t: My heart is filled with hidden pain that is hard to endure, and so my conduct has slightly overstepped propriety; for that fault I offer no excuse.

units.source_text: 但倘不得公主许可，决不敢再求更进一步的亲近。

en.t: But without your permission, Princess, I would never dare to seek any closer intimacy.

units.source_text: 我实在是‘柔肠寸断苦难言’啊！

en.t: Truly, my tender heart is torn to pieces, and the pain is beyond words!

units.source_text: 公主虽不赏脸，自然总有几分理解我的心事。

en.t: Though you will not favor me with your attention, Princess, surely you understand at least a little of what is in my heart.

units.source_text: 但故意装作不知，待我如此冷淡，使我无法申诉，我就顾不得冒昧了。

en.t: But you deliberately pretend not to know and treat me so coldly that I have no way to plead my case, so I can no longer worry about being presumptuous.

units.source_text: 即使公主把我看作可恨的负心人，我也不惜，

en.t: Even if you regard me as a hateful and faithless man, Princess, I do not care.

units.source_text: 但求把年来淤塞在胸中的愁闷向公主分明告白而已。

en.t: I ask only to clearly confess to you the sorrow that has been pent up in my heart for years.

units.source_text: 公主对我如此薄情，虽然使我伤心，但我决不敢放肆……”

en.t: Though your coldness toward me wounds me deeply, Princess, I would never dare behave wantonly..."

units.source_text: 他强自镇定，装作情深意密的模样。

en.t: He forced himself to remain composed and put on an air of deep and intimate affection.

units.source_text: 公主虽然一直拉住纸隔扇，但这防御绝不巩固。

en.t: Although the princess kept holding the paper partition shut, this defense was by no means secure.

units.source_text: 夕雾也不强要开门。

en.t: Yugiri did not force the door open either.

units.source_text: 但笑着说道：“靠这一点阻隔来聊以自慰，也很可怜了！”

en.t: Instead he laughed and said, "To take comfort in this slight barrier is rather pitiful!"

units.source_text: 他并不任意妄为。

en.t: He did not act recklessly or do whatever he pleased.

units.source_text: 可见此人性行温和文雅，即在此时，亦与别人不同。

en.t: This shows that his nature was gentle and refined; even at such a moment, he was different from other men.
